description: This PHP source file is a class definition for a main event listener implementing Symfony's EventSubscriberInterface. It handles various hook points related to forum functionalities such as viewing forums, topics, posting, and attribute management in a phpBB-based extension called 'Quick Title Edition Extension'. The class interacts with different components like request, template, user, log, and a custom 'qte' class to modify event data, assign template variables, and log attribute changes.

classes.name: main_listener
classes.description: A class that subscribes to forum-related events to modify data and user interface elements related to attribute display and assignment, as part of a phpBB extension.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping event names to handler methods, defining which events this listener subscribes to.

methods.name: viewforum_assign_topic_attributes
methods.description: Assigns a display value for topic attributes in the view forum page if the attribute ID is present.

methods.name: viewforum_get_user_infos
methods.description: Fetches user information related to topics when viewing a forum with a list of topics.

methods.name: viewtopic_attr_title
methods.description: Modifies the page title by prepending the attribute title if available for the current topic.

methods.name: viewtopic_select_assign_attributes
methods.description: Assigns attribute display and selection variables in the view topic page.

methods.name: viewtopic_attr_apply
methods.description: Handles applying an attribute to a topic based on a request variable.

methods.name: posting_select_assign_attributes
methods.description: Handles attribute selection in the posting form, including special handling based on the posting mode.

methods.name: posting_check_attribute
methods.description: Validates that a required attribute is selected before posting.

methods.name: posting_submit_data
methods.description: Prepares attribute data before submitting a post.

methods.name: posting_save_attribute
methods.description: Saves attribute changes to the database and logs modifications after a post is submitted.
